note:
R113 (review 2026-09-26 r107-r112, queue items 1-3) - league schedule stock-partition contract, field check and cross-source coverage.

Sources: every main-database anchor (27 files; X360 / PS3 gen7 pairs are byte-identical per title and measured once, aliases recorded), the
real NHL 20 install copy (1e200478..), NHL 19 patch 56 (61332e66..) and NHL 15 PS4 patch 00 (abe36f58..) from the private fixture root; the
patch files carry no meta member, so the title's base meta is used after checking that every table id of that meta is present.

Per source and league schedule table (stems below; tournament, NHL, AHL and debug tables excluded):
  league   : PS4 = the title's own `stockleagues.name` key; otherwise a named member club (fullname), else the club abbreviation.
  slots    : schedule `home` / `away` values = the league's `exhibitionteams` rows ranked by `index` (R13 convention), checked by the validator.
  model    : one pair count for every pair -> round robin k; two counts whose higher-count graph is a set of complete cliques covering the
             members -> stock partition (within / across quotas); anything else -> irregular (no model; pair summary only).
  contract : members (rank, index, artabbr, abbrname, name), mapping fingerprint = SHA-256 of the canonical [rank, index, artabbr] list,
             groups as ranks and as indices, quotas, clique completeness computed from the schedule graph.
  validator: fingerprint vs current members; partition validity; every unordered pair incl. zero-count pairs; all participants; no self game;
             no slot outside 0..n-1; per-team totals; directional home / away counts. Controls per contract: a dropped game, a swapped
             membership, a stale mapping (two members' indices exchanged), an out-of-range slot and a self game must each be detected.
  field    : for partition leagues, every table of the database is scanned: key columns whose values cover every member's `index` (or its
             `artid`), then every other column of that table is tested for inducing exactly the partition (single value per member, equal
             inside a group, different across groups). Everything scanned is counted; what is not scanned is listed in the handoff.
Read-only. Usage: python r113_group_partitions.py <out.json>
